summary: All amounts are in United States dollars, unless otherwise stated. TORONTO, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Alamos Gold Inc. summary: HACKENSACK, N.J., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FirstService Residential, North America's leading residential community management company, is proud to announce that it has been selected to provide full-service property management for Executive House, a distinguished high-rise community in Hackensack, New Jersey.
title: FirstService Residential Expands Its New Jersey Footprint, Welcoming Executive House in Hackensack, NJ
